Class HttpServer

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.jdk.net.httpserver.HttpServer
Direct Known Subclasses:
HttpsServer
public class HttpServer extends Object
A bounded, single-connection subset of the JDK HttpServer, dispatched cooperatively by handleNext(). Context handlers and the exchange are allocated when the server is configured; request polling reuses its body buffer and exchange object.
